text.p: LONDON, Aug 6 (Rueter) - IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Wednesday it had assigned Russia's Probusinessbank a long-term rating of B plus, a short term rating of B, an individual rating of D and a legal rating of 5T.

"Probusinessbank's (PBB) short track record, its market share, the high degrees of concentration in the loan portfolio and funding base, and the more competitive economic environment in Russia in 1997, have been reflected in the individual and long-term ratings," IBCA said in a statement.
IBCA said that its opinion that support from the state and shareholders, although possible, could not be relied upon, was reflected in the legal rating.
